notes.page_content: Continuation of a proof in the case ringed T cap Gamma is nonempty. It constructs a convex hull, invokes IV for a visible y and V for an edge, argues with an auxiliary triangle, concludes a visible vertex, then states a corollary asserting a pair of distinct polygon vertices with exterior visibility and connecting open interval on the hull boundary.
